_README: Per-window companion-guide content, keyed by window id (0-6).
This is the ONLY file to edit when guide copy changes. Copy and audio for a
window live in the same record so they swap as a unit.
Any field left as an empty string falls back to the generated summary in
lib/window-content.ts, so a window can never render a blank modal. A window
using ANY fallback field is flagged in the UI as 'Placeholder copy'.
Fields:
title           heading in the modal (defaults to the window name)
whyThisMatters  short orientation, always visible
watchForThis    one sharpening line, always visible
fullGuide       complete companion-guide copy, revealed by the expander.
Blank paragraphs split on a double newline. If empty, the
expander is not rendered at all.
dismissLabel    dismiss button text
audio.intro     narration for the window's intro block (top strip)
audio.guide     narration of the guide copy itself (inside the modal)
Set either to null to hide that control.
This file is shell content, NOT L4 corpus data. It deliberately does not
live in windows.json: the audit repo is read-only to this app, and guide
copy is editorial rather than evidentiary.
